arabic text: WAWAILA HAAYE WAWAILA\nSAB MILKE KARE AB EHLE AZA
english translation text: O MOURNERS OF HUSAIN\nGATHER TOGETHER AND LAMENT

arabic text:
ISLAM NABI KA BACHAYA HAI
TAKBEER KA DEEP JALAYA HAI
QURAN KA MAAN BADHAYA HAI
TAWHEED PE GHAR KO LUTAYA HAI
SHABBIR KA MATAM WAWAILA
DILGEER KA MATAM WAWAILA
YE EHLE AZA KA HAI NAWHA
english translation text:
HE SAVED THE PROPHET'S RELIGION OF ISLAM
HE LIT THE CANDLE OF TAKBEER
HE ELEVATED THE IMPORTANCE/ STATUS OF THE QURAN
HE SACRIFICED HIS FAMILY FOR THE SAKE OF ALLAH
O MOURNERS OF HUSAIN
GATHER TOGETHER AND LAMENT

arabic text:
HAM SHAKLE PAYAMBAR MAARA GAYA
CHE MAAH KA ASGHER MAARA GAYA
ABBAS-E DILAWAR MAARA GAYA
SHABBIR KA DILBAR MAARA GAYA
AKBAR KA MAATAM WAWAILA
ASGHER KA MAATAM WAWAILA
ZAINAB KA LABON PAR THI YE SADA
english translation text:
THE ONE WHO RESEMBLED THE HOLY PROPHET WAS MARTYRED
SIX MONTH OLD ALI ASGHAR WAS MARTYRED
THE BRAVE ABBAS WAS MARTYRED
AND THE BELOVED OF SHABBIR WAS MARTYRED
ZAINAB CRIED OUT
GATHER TOGETHER AND LAMENT FOR AKBAR AND ASGHAR

arabic text:
KAISE HO RAQAM EHWAAL-E JAFA
AADAA NE SITAM KUCH AISA KIYA
QAASIM KA JO SAD PAAMAAL HUWA
BEHAAL HUWI UMME FARWA
QAASIM KA MAATAM WAWAILA
BEKAS KA MAATAM WAWAILA
QASIM KA GHAM HAI AUR KUBRA
english translation text:
HOW CAN ONE NARRATE THE TYPE OF ATROCITIES THAT WERE COMMITTED BY THE ENEMIES
QASIM'S BODY WAS TRAMPLED BY HORSES
UM FARWA'S GRIEF WAS UNCONTROLLABLE
THE MOURNERS CRIED OUT
GATHER TOGETHER AND LAMENT FOR QASIM
LAMENT FOR THE HELPLESS ONE

arabic text:
KYA GHURBAT KI TANHAAYI THI
JAB SHAME GHARIBAN AAYI THI
EK ZULM KI BADLY CHAAI THI
PAYGHAAM-E ASEERI LAAYI THI
GHURBAT KA MAATAM WAWAILA
ITRAT KA MAATAM WAWAILA
SAB EHLE HARAM KI CHEENI RIDA
english translation text:
WHEN SHAM E GHARIBAN CAME
THE WOMEN AND CHILDREN WERE ALONE AND HELPLESS
A CLOUD OF OPPRESSION WAS LOOMING OVER THEM
AND WARNING THEM ABOUT THEIR IMPENDING IMPRISONMENT
EVEN THEIR VEILS WERE SNATCHED AWAY
GATHER TOGETHER AND LAMENT FOR THE FAMILY OF THE PROPHET (S)

arabic text:
PAABAND-E SALAASIL EHLE HARAM
KHAAMOSH UTHAAYE BAARE SITAM
HAI MEHVE SAFAR LARZIDA QADAM
SEENO MEIN LIYE SHABBIR KA GHAM
MAZLOOM KA MATAM WAWAILA
MAASOOM KA MATAM WAWAILA
KARTA HAI FALAQ UNPAR GIRYA
english translation text:
THE WOMEN OF THE AHLUL BAYT HAVE BEEN TIED IN CHAINS
THEY ARE SILENTLY BEARING THE BURDENS OF OPPRESSION ON THEIR SHOULDERS
THEY ARE TREMBLING AS THEY TRAVEL
CARRYING THE PAIN OF HUSSAIN (A.S.) IN THEIR HEARTS
THERE WAS A CRY IN THE SKY
GATHER TOGETHER AND LAMENT FOR THE OPPRESSED & INNOCENT

arabic text:
BICHTAA HAI JAHAA(N) PAR FARHS-E AZAA
HOTA HAI JAHAA(N) PAR GHAM BARPA
PURSE KO POHONCHTI HAI ZAHRA
KARTI HUWI SAARIM YE NOHA
SARWAR KA MATAM WAWAILA
GHAR GHAR KA MATAM WAWAILA
PYAARO PAR KARTI HAI ROZ BUKA
english translation text:
WHEREVER A MAJLIS TAKES PLACE
WHEREVER THERE IS MOURNING FOR HUSSAIN (A.S.)
BIBI ZAHRA (S.A.) COMES TO ACCEPT CONDOLENCES
AND SHE SAYS
GATHER TOGETHER AND LAMENT FOR MY HUSSAIN (A.S.)
